g.text: Distributive justice does most of the work, and usually works alone

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: The seven ways the three classifiers can combine on a passage, across the 896,744 passages carrying at least one justice label.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Bars are disjoint: every justice-labelled passage falls in exactly one of these seven columns, so they sum to 100%.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: Left-hand bars are each classifier's own total, which do overlap and so sum to more than 100%. Percentages above each bar are

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #52514e

g.text: its share of all justice-labelled passages.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Coloured bars are passages where a single classifier fired; grey bars are passages carrying more than one label.

text.style: font-size: 7.4px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #8a8983

g.text: Source: Climate Policy Radar, PRODUCTION.PUBLISHED.PASSAGES (Snowflake), Aug 2026. Body text passages only (content_type='Text', >=20 chars), published non-principal documents.
